candidates.headline: City to continue to investigate safety improvements for Howard Street
candidates.summary:
Building and business Building and business Planning applications on public notice Tenders Building fences Bendigo Airport

Following a community consultation process, the Greater Bendigo City Council has voted not to undertake a trial banning heavy vehicle access between 8am and 9.30am and 2.30pm and 4pm, Monday to Friday in Howard Street, between Midland Highway and Goynes Road Epsom.

The community engagement was undertaken following a request from the Victorian Government’s Department of Transport and Planning (DTP) who had received significant feedback received from Epsom residents regarding safety concerns associated with heavy vehicle movements through the area, particularly during peak periods when school and commuter traffic is at its highest.

City of Greater Bendigo Mayor Cr Thomas Prince said while the City will not proceed with the trial, it will continue to investigate, review, implement and advocate for traffic safety improvements within the Howard Street corridor and surrounding road network in partnership with government agencies and stakeholders.
